containmentActiveBody: This agent can only read and mutate work inside its assigned review boundary. Raw output is quarantined from higher-trust agents until a trusted reviewer promotes it.
containmentMissingBody: This agent is set to low-trust review, but no project, root issue, or issue scope is set in the core policy. Add a scope before this agent can run without denial.
ceNote: CE saves one containment boundary at a time. Saved policies include this organization id.
managedByEeBody: This policy has {{summary}} and cannot be edited by the CE single-boundary editor.
moreBoundaries: Want to set more than one containment boundary?
advancedNote: Advanced permissions remain editable through the EE permissions extension when installed.
trustPresetHint: Choose how broadly this agent can read and act on Paperclip work objects.
